spots.name: Otterndorf

spots.name: Cuxhaven – Sahlenburg
spots.notes: Large standing area; about 4 h either side of high tide.

spots.name: Cuxhaven – Kugelbake
spots.notes: Elbe mouth: current and shipping lane. National park zone, about 3 h either side of high tide. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Usedom – Ückeritz (Achterwasser)
spots.notes: Achterwasser by the harbour: standing area, choppy; best W–S.

spots.name: Salzhaff – Pepelow

spots.name: Pelzerhaken

spots.name: Usedom – Karlshagen
spots.notes: Sportstrand with kite school; waves in E winds, W winds are offshore. Keep clear of the swimming zone.

spots.name: Gahlkow
spots.notes: Greifswalder Bodden: narrow beach, choppy and gusty.

spots.name: Büsum – Perlebucht
spots.notes: Northern part of the Perlebucht lagoon only; tidal, ride around high tide. Shoreline bends here (215° locally vs 245° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Usedom – Peenemünde
spots.notes: Choppy, deepens quickly; few facilities. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Warnemünde
spots.notes: Kite access at beach access 13, west of the pier; rough waves in strong N–NW wind.

spots.name: Saal (Saaler Bodden)
spots.notes: Shallow flat water almost everywhere; kite school on site.

spots.name: Sankt Peter-Ording

spots.name: Wustrow
spots.notes: Baltic side: waves (German Kitesurf Open venue). Bodden side: flat shallow water.

spots.name: Großenbrode
spots.notes: Flat water and small waves.

spots.name: Heiligenhafen
spots.notes: Steinwarder, east of the pier: wind waves, beginner zone in the shallows.

spots.name: Fehmarn – Wulfener Hals

spots.name: Laboe

spots.name: Stein

spots.name: Fehmarn – Gold
spots.notes: Huge shallow standing area, busy with schools; stones in the north part.

spots.name: Zingst
spots.notes: Sportstrand at the edge of town; choppy, deep enough for foiling.

spots.name: Fehmarn – Lemkenhafen (Orther Reede)
spots.notes: Flat shallow water in the Orther Reede. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (225° locally vs 189° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Rügen – Suhrendorf (Ummanz)
spots.notes: Bodden: shallow flat water, beginner-friendly.

spots.name: Husum – Dockkoog
spots.notes: Wadden Sea, around high tide. Busy in summer; no-go channel south of the point. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Fehmarn – Grüner Brink
spots.notes: North coast: works in E winds when other spots are offshore; shared with a dog beach.

spots.name: Nordstrand – Holmer Siel
spots.notes: Wadden Sea: about 5 h around high tide; groyne fields (Lahnungen) at low water.

spots.name: Rügen – Wiek

spots.name: Rügen – Dranske
spots.notes: Wieker Bodden side: flat water.

spots.name: Dagebüll
spots.notes: Wadden Sea, by the ferry pier; around high tide only.

spots.name: Sylt – Hörnum Möwennest
spots.notes: Wadden side behind the Möwennest hostel: flat shallow water for E winds. National park: only about 2–3 h either side of low tide.

spots.name: Sylt – K4 (Hörnum)
spots.notes: West beach 4 km north of Hörnum: flat channels at low tide, waves at high tide; strong coastal current.

spots.name: Flensburger Förde – Schausende
spots.notes: Fjord spot with a small standing area; boat traffic and occasional nets.

spots.name: Flensburger Förde – Holnis
spots.notes: Fjord spot, shallow near shore; marked kite zone in summer.

spots.name: Sylt – Westerland
spots.notes: Brandenburger Strand: Germany's main wave spot, strong current between the groynes. Experienced riders.

spots.name: Sylt – List (Königshafen)
spots.notes: Wadden Sea, shallow flat water. Nature reserve: launch only from the kite beach, ride inside the buoys, about 2–3 h either side of high tide.

spots.name: Gran Canaria – Bahía Feliz
spots.notes: Smaller waves than Pozo / Vargas; school (Club Mistral).

spots.name: Gran Canaria – Pozo Izquierdo
spots.notes: Very strong wind, waves, rocky: experts.

spots.name: Gran Canaria – Vargas
spots.notes: Strong trade wind Apr–Sep; waves.

spots.name: Tenerife – El Médano
spots.notes: Trade wind May–Oct; shallow water at the north end.

spots.name: Fuerteventura – Sotavento
spots.notes: Lagoon at low tide (flat, knee-deep); open sea at high tide. World Cup venue.

spots.name: Fuerteventura – Costa Calma
spots.notes: Flatter water, fewer riders than Sotavento.

spots.name: Lanzarote – Playa Honda
spots.notes: Best Lanzarote option in easterlies: long beach, flat water.

spots.name: Lanzarote – Costa Teguise
spots.notes: Las Cucharas; waves, schools; gusty close to shore. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Lanzarote – Famara
spots.notes: Waves, trade wind; currents.

spots.name: Tarifa – Balneario
spots.notes: Experts only (rocks, currents); levante freestyle, poniente waves. No kiting 15 Jun–15 Sep.

spots.name: Tarifa – Los Lances
spots.notes: Los Lances Norte (Río Jara–Waves). Summer: school and free-rider zones only, no kiting from Río Jara to town 15 Jun–15 Sep.

spots.name: Tarifa – Valdevaqueros
spots.notes: Includes Punta Paloma; summer kite zone is crowded; rocks at low tide.

spots.name: Bolonia
spots.notes: No kiting in summer.

spots.name: Algeciras – Palmones
spots.notes: Strong-levante alternative to Tarifa (weaker wind); no kiting in summer; keep out of the river and marsh reserve.

spots.name: Los Caños de Meca
spots.notes: Levante spot; rocks towards the lighthouse at low tide; officially no kiting in summer. Shoreline bends here (130° locally vs 189° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: El Palmar (Vejer)
spots.notes: Westerlies; ride the south end, watch surfers and bathers; rocks at low tide.

spots.name: Chiclana – Sancti Petri
spots.notes: Winter: free; summer only inside the water-sports channels.

spots.name: San Fernando – Camposoto
spots.notes: Westerlies; summer channel at the end of the promenade; local kite club.

spots.name: Cádiz – Cortadura
spots.notes: Westerlies; rocky bottom, high tide recommended.

spots.name: Marbella – Los Monteros
spots.notes: Río Real: summer access only through the buoyed channel (levante); poniente waves in winter. Rocky entry.

spots.name: El Puerto – Valdelagrana
spots.notes: Space in winter and summer (summer water-sports channel).

spots.name: Rota – El Rompidillo
spots.notes: Winter spot for all levels; move elsewhere in the bathing season. Shoreline bends here (106° locally vs 135° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Málaga – Los Álamos
spots.notes: Official kite zone (Los Álamos / Guadalmar), moved during the bathing season; SW thermal Apr–Oct.

spots.name: Almerimar
spots.notes: Poniente (W) spot by the marina: flat between the breakwaters, waves further out.

spots.name: Motril – Playa Granada
spots.notes: Levante and poniente; shorebreak in strong poniente. School on the beach.

spots.name: Roquetas de Mar – Las Salinas
spots.notes: Long beach used in poniente and levante; restricted during the bathing season.

spots.name: Almería – El Zapillo
spots.notes: City beach, poniente side-shore; no kiting 15 Jun–15 Sep.

spots.name: Ayamonte – Isla Canela
spots.notes: Shallow sandbars by the Guadiana mouth, beginner-friendly; SW thermal Apr–Sep.

spots.name: Punta Umbría
spots.notes: Long open beach with waves; SW thermal; summer restrictions near bathers.

spots.name: Isla Cristina – La Casita Azul
spots.notes: Designated kite zone; restricted from 15 Jun in summer.

spots.name: El Portil
spots.notes: Flat water behind the El Rompido sandspit (cross the Río Piedras); strong currents.

spots.name: Mar Menor – Los Nietos
spots.notes: Shallow flat water, onshore in NE/E; beginner-friendly, no summer restriction at the end of the promenade.

spots.name: La Manga – Isla del Ciervo
spots.notes: Mar Menor side at km 3; summer jellyfish nets close the bathing areas (no riding inside).

spots.name: Mar Menor – Los Narejos
spots.notes: Flat-water lagoon, kite zone and school; E and SW (lebeche) most common. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Guardamar – Els Tossals
spots.notes: Designated kite area by the dunes.

spots.name: Santa Pola – La Gola
spots.notes: La Gola open to kites year-round; neighbouring Playa Lisa is closed to kites in summer.

spots.name: Elche – Arenales del Sol
spots.notes: Municipal kite area with schools.

spots.name: Dénia – Les Deveses
spots.notes: Marked kite zone at the north end of Dénia (Les Deveses); summer thermal and winter tramuntana.

spots.name: Oliva
spots.notes: Oliva Nova; in summer kiting only in the authorised zone (club rescue boat).

spots.name: Sueca – Mareny de Barraquetes
spots.notes: Summer channel (Jun–Aug) for Barraquetes Vent club members only; free off-season. Summer garbí thermal.

spots.name: Valencia – El Perellonet
spots.notes: Municipal buoyed kite zone south of the Perellonet river mouth, open year-round; Kitezone club.

spots.name: Mallorca – Son Serra de Marina
spots.notes: Island's main kite beach Oct–May; summer restrictions.

spots.name: Mallorca – Platja de Muro
spots.notes: Small authorised channel; crowded in summer, best off-season.

spots.name: Burriana – El Arenal
spots.notes: Winter spot for southerlies; flat water between the harbour moles.

spots.name: Mallorca – Pollença (Sa Marina)
spots.notes: Authorised kite zone and schools in the Bay of Pollença.

spots.name: Menorca – Son Bou
spots.notes: Waves in westerlies; summer: designated launch area only.

spots.name: Menorca – Cala Tirant
spots.notes: Waves with the tramuntana (N); summer: designated launch area only. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: El Trabucador (Ebro delta)
spots.notes: Authorised summer kite zone; flat water on the Badia dels Alfacs (west) side.

spots.name: Platja dels Eucaliptus (Ebro delta)
spots.notes: Shallow water at the root of the Trabucador; beginner-friendly.

spots.name: Riumar (Ebro delta)
spots.notes: Authorised summer kite zone; best in mestral (NW, cross-shore), summer southerlies are offshore.

spots.name: La Pineda
spots.notes: Kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep (Catalan coast rule). Shoreline bends here (136° locally vs 183° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Torredembarra
spots.notes: Off-season spot: kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep. Keep off the protected Muntanyans dunes east of town.

spots.name: Castelldefels
spots.notes: Authorised summer kite zone (online registration required).

spots.name: Barcelona – Nova Mar Bella
spots.notes: No official kite zone: kiting banned 1 Jun–30 Sep; off-season levante / gregal days only.

spots.name: Malgrat de Mar – La Pomareda
spots.notes: Municipal kite zone looked after by Club Kite Malgrat; SW thermal Mar–Sep.

spots.name: Embalse de La Loteta
spots.notes: Reservoir ridden in the cierzo (NW), which blows along its length; south launch area with Club Kitesurf La Loteta. Shallow and rocky in places: check the water level.

spots.name: L'Estartit – Gola del Ter
spots.notes: Summer kite zone (1 Jun–30 Sep) run by the local school; kite pass / registration required.

spots.name: Sant Pere Pescador
spots.notes: Authorised summer kite zone (beginner and advanced sectors); tramuntana and summer thermal.

spots.name: Vigo – O Vao
spots.notes: Flat water behind the Toralla island in W–NW.

spots.name: Empuriabrava – La Rubina
spots.notes: Authorised summer kite zone at the Santa Margarida end (natural park beach); best in easterlies.

spots.name: Redondela – Cesantes
spots.notes: Flat water at the head of the Vigo ría; SW summer thermal. Shoreline bends here (234° locally vs 264° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: A Lanzada
spots.notes: Huge exposed beach; best autumn–winter.

spots.name: O Grove – A Mexilloeira
spots.notes: Sheltered ría beach: flat water in N–NE; school.

spots.name: A Illa de Arousa – O Bao
spots.notes: Flat water in the ría; works in S–SE (winter).

spots.name: Razo (Carballo)
spots.notes: Open Atlantic (waves); the Baldaio lagoon next door is flat at high tide.

spots.name: Laredo – Salvé
spots.notes: Flat water; stay upwind of bathers.

spots.name: Somo
spots.notes: Waves on the open beach; flat water in La Poza (Miera estuary) at low–mid tide, schools there.

spots.name: Santander – Los Peligros
spots.notes: Bay beach for SW (gusty, choppy); no kiting 1 Jun–30 Sep.

spots.name: Doniños (Ferrol)
spots.notes: Exposed Atlantic beach: waves, experienced riders.

spots.name: Gijón – San Lorenzo
spots.notes: NE–E; launch space depends on the tide; summer restrictions.

spots.name: Gijón – El Arbeyal
spots.notes: Sheltered by the breakwater, N–NE; all levels. Space depends on the tide. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Salinas – San Juan de Nieva
spots.notes: Strong wind and waves; advanced riders.

spots.name: Luanco – Santa Marina
spots.notes: Protected by jetties; works in E–SE and N. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Kalajoki – Hiekkasärkät
spots.notes: Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (288° locally vs 317° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Bonifacio – Piantarella
spots.notes: Shallow flat water behind the sandbank to Piana island; E / NE wind (avoid W). July–August: no room to rig, schools only. Shoreline bends here (85° locally vs 116° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Bonifacio – Tonnara
spots.notes: World-renowned W (libeccio) spot in the Ventilègne gulf; flat by east wind. The closed bay of Pont de Ventilègne next door suits beginners. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Bonifacio – Balistra
spots.notes: Wild beach with a shallow lagoon behind it. Flat water by W (offshore, venturi), small waves by E. The local school closed in 2023.

spots.name: Figari – Baie de Figari
spots.notes: Closed, shallow bay, very safe: ideal for beginners. Works with W (thermal, libeccio, mistral). Large kite school.

spots.name: Porto-Pollo – Plage du Taravo
spots.notes: Summer thermal almost every afternoon; kite zone marked by yellow buoys (managed by an association). Good for beginners and foil.

spots.name: Argelès-sur-Mer – Le Racou
spots.notes: Summer (June–Sept): kite only in the buoyed zone, reached through the marked channel. Waves with marin (SE), tramontane offshore.

spots.name: Calvi – La Pinède
spots.notes: Big sandy bay; W (libeccio) and NE. Summer: head to the north-east end of the beach, away from swimmers.

spots.name: Saint-Cyprien / Canet – Pont des Basses
spots.notes: Kite zone regulated by municipal decree from May to September (marked channel). Waves with SE / thermal; tramontane offshore: experienced riders.

spots.name: Torreilles – Le Blockhaus
spots.notes: Summer kite zone left of the lifeguard post (north beach, towards the Agly mouth). Works with SE / thermal; tramontane offshore.

spots.name: Le Barcarès – Les 3 Colonnes
spots.notes: Official kite zone; narrow launch behind the dunes. Waves with marin (SE) and summer thermal; tramontane offshore.

spots.name: Le Barcarès – Parc des Dosses (Étang de Leucate)
spots.notes: Flat water by tramontane (offshore, often 30 kn+): experienced riders; no launching on the main lagoon side, keep clear of the wake cable. UCPA Éole (Cap Coudalère) next door suits intermediates. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Leucate – Le Goulet
spots.notes: Shallow flat water on the Étang de Leucate below Leucate village; first place the tramontane hits. Helmet and impact vest recommended (shallow). Shoreline bends here (270° locally vs 244° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Leucate – Les Coussoules / La Franqui
spots.notes: Famous tramontane spot (Mondial du Vent); the tramontane (NW) is offshore here: experts only. Waves with marin (SE). Summer: kite zones only.

spots.name: Étang de La Palme
spots.notes: Shallow flat-water lagoon, safe by tramontane (onshore at the launch); schools on site. Good for learning. Shoreline bends here (267° locally vs 213° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Port-la-Nouvelle
spots.notes: Wide beach exposed to the tramontane (offshore: experienced riders) and to marin (waves). Summer: kite zone only.

spots.name: Hyères – L'Almanarre
spots.notes: World-famous W / SW spot. Kite zone between beach gates 16 and 21 with marked channel; ride beyond the 300 m buoys. Crowded in summer (15 June–15 Sept rules).

spots.name: Gruissan – La Vieille Nouvelle
spots.notes: Glassy water by tramontane, which is offshore and strong: experienced riders, drift risk, no lifeguards. Sandy track access (2.15 m height bar). No riding on the Étang de l'Ayrolle.

spots.name: Six-Fours – Le Brusc
spots.notes: Plage des Charmettes, sheltered from swell by the Embiez islands; SW to NW (mistral). Technical launch (rocks). Kiting banned June–September.

spots.name: Gruissan – Les Chalets / Grazel
spots.notes: Sea side: Défi Wind beach, waves with marin, tramontane offshore. Étang du Grazel: small enclosed shallow lagoon used by the kite school, flat in any wind.

spots.name: Hyères – Le Mérou
spots.notes: Hyères' second official kite zone (L'Ayguade), for east wind: flat by west wind, choppy by east wind. Small launch area: intermediate / advanced.

spots.name: Narbonne – La Nautique
spots.notes: Étang de Bages-Sigean nautical base; kite sector in the south-east part of the lagoon. Flat water by tramontane. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (195° locally vs 226° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Narbonne-Plage – Créneau Naturel
spots.notes: Wild beach west of Narbonne-Plage with a kite zone. Flat water by tramontane (offshore), waves with marin.

spots.name: Saint-Pierre-la-Mer – Pissevaches
spots.notes: 300 m kite-only zone run by a school (day pass and RC insurance required, open on tramontane days). Must be able to ride upwind.

spots.name: Marseille – Pointe Rouge
spots.notes: Mistral spot (Pointe Rouge / Bonneveine): advanced riders. Kiting banned on the beaches in summer (about mid-June to mid-September). Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (323° locally vs 290° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Sérignan – La Grande Maïre
spots.notes: Summer: kite only in the short zone between Sérignan-Plage and Portiragnes-Plage. Thermal / marin sea breeze.

spots.name: Agde – La Tamarissière
spots.notes: Only beach in Agde where kiting is allowed in summer (kite zone near the Hérault mouth). Works with W to SE winds.

spots.name: Lac de la Ganguise
spots.notes: Kite tolerated only in a small zone reached via the Auberge Le Cathare (Belflou). Venturi with autan (SE), often 25–30 kn+. Not for beginners; leave the water when firefighting planes operate. Shoreline bends here (36° locally vs 89° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Marseillan – Étang de Thau
spots.notes: Western Étang de Thau near Marseillan-Plage / Maldormir: flat shallow water by tramontane. Keep clear of oyster farms; check local rules (association Camikas). Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (303° locally vs 1° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Carro
spots.notes: Experienced riders only: tight rocky launch, big waves and currents. SE side-shore; mistral irregular.

spots.name: Salin-de-Giraud – Piémanson
spots.notes: Long wild beach; best S–SW. Strong currents near the Rhône mouth with SE wind.

spots.name: Port-Saint-Louis – Plage Napoléon
spots.notes: Isolated sand spit (protected area); works SE to SSW. All levels.

spots.name: Sète – Les 3 Digues
spots.notes: One of the few beaches where kiting is allowed in summer (kite zone). Thermal / SW onshore; avoid north wind (offshore, gusty).

spots.name: Port-Saint-Louis – Carteau
spots.notes: Closed bay of the Golfe de Fos: flat water with S / SE wind, beginner to intermediate. Mistral is gusty here; beware of drifting onto the mussel farms.

spots.name: Hendaye
spots.notes: Only Basque beach without cliffs. Banned 1 July–31 August.

spots.name: Beauduc
spots.notes: Legendary Camargue spot, huge beach and flat bay; mistral and S–SW. Remote: dirt track, vehicles max 2.10 m wide, no cars on the beach.

spots.name: Fréjus – Saint-Aygulf
spots.notes: Summer: kite zone at the Argens mouth (Base Nature side); late Sept to early June: Saint-Aygulf (Esclamandes) kite zone. Thermal S and E winds.

spots.name: Sète – Pont-Levis
spots.notes: Étang de Thau reference flat-water spot. Launch from the sandbank safe zone, one kite at a time; tramontane (NW) onshore. Booties (urchins). Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Marignane – Le Jaï
spots.notes: 5 km sand strip on the Étang de Berre, one of the windiest places in Provence; mistral (strong, gusty), SE and W thermal. Schools on site.

spots.name: Fos-sur-Mer – Le Cavaou
spots.notes: Beach at the end of the road; SE / E for waves. Kiting banned in summer (about mid-June to mid-September). Shoreline bends here (148° locally vs 121° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Mèze – La Pinède
spots.notes: North shore of the Étang de Thau; flat water, backup spot when the sea is too rough. School on site. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Frontignan – Étang d'Ingril
spots.notes: Shallow lagoon behind Frontignan-Plage: you stand almost everywhere. Good for learning; flat by tramontane. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Saintes-Maries-de-la-Mer – Plage Est
spots.notes: Only beach of Saintes-Maries where kiting is tolerated (paid access). Continues east towards Beauduc.

spots.name: Le Grau-du-Roi – L'Espiguette
spots.notes: Huge wild beach; works S, SE, SW and NW. Long walk from the car park; crowded in summer.

spots.name: Villeneuve-lès-Maguelone – Maguelone
spots.notes: Summer: kiting only in the Maguelone zone (Prévost beach banned in summer; little train from the car park). Tramontane is offshore: safety boat compulsory.

spots.name: Anglet – La Madrague
spots.notes: Waves, experienced riders. Allowed November–May; in season only early morning and after 19:00 via the marked channel.

spots.name: Port-Camargue – Plage Sud
spots.notes: Sheltered behind the long jetties; flat water by NW / mistral (offshore-ish): experienced riders. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (270° locally vs 295° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Cannes – Palm Beach
spots.notes: Only kite spot of Cannes (Pointe de la Croisette, old heliport launch). Very narrow rocky launch, boat traffic: experienced riders only. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Le Grau-du-Roi – Le Boucanet
spots.notes: Experienced riders; best with west wind and waves, also S.

spots.name: Carnon – Petit Travers
spots.notes: Long wild beach between Carnon and La Grande-Motte; works S to SW. Les Roquilles (Carnon west) is forbidden in summer.

spots.name: La Grande-Motte
spots.notes: Two designated kite zones: by the port / nautical club (Couchant) and at Grand Travers. Works S to SW; small waves.

spots.name: Lac du Salagou
spots.notes: Kite tolerated (Natura 2000). Small grassy launch with trees, left of the road before the campsite: advanced riders. Tramontane stronger than on the coast. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Seignosse – Les Estagnots
spots.notes: Waves and current, experienced riders. Only Seignosse beach where kiting is allowed; June–September: signposted zone south of the car park during bathing hours.

spots.name: Moliets
spots.notes: Waves; large area near the Huchet river mouth, best at high tide.

spots.name: Contis
spots.notes: Watch the jetties near the river mouth.

spots.name: Mimizan
spots.notes: Plage Sud kite zone; keep away from the river mouth currents.

spots.name: Lac de Cazaux – Navarrosse
spots.notes: Flat, shallow lake (Cazaux-Sanguinet), south shore. Navarrosse launch September–May; June–August use the kite zone at Mayotte (just east). Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Biscarrosse-Plage
spots.notes: Waves; summer kite zone south of the bathing area.

spots.name: Lac de Sanguinet – Port de l'Estey
spots.notes: Water launch, intermediate riders; avoid the buoyed zone to the north. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: La Teste – La Salie
spots.notes: Ocean beach at the south end of the basin entrance; supervised zone late June–early September.

spots.name: Lac de Serre-Ponçon – Boscodon / Crots
spots.notes: Only kite spot of the lake (Plage des Eaux Douces, Crots, with school). Thermal wind from late morning; kiting forbidden near the bridge and in bathing areas.

spots.name: Bassin d'Arcachon – La Hume
spots.notes: Tidal basin: ride around high tide. Closed in the hunting season (October–November). Shoreline bends here (293° locally vs 319° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Bassin d'Arcachon – Les Arbousiers
spots.notes: Sandbank at low tide, strong current at high tide. Banned in summer.

spots.name: Bassin d'Arcachon – Andernos (Le Bétey)
spots.notes: Tidal basin, around high tide only. Closed July–August.

spots.name: Bassin d'Arcachon – Claouey
spots.notes: Tidal basin, 2–3 h either side of high tide; muddy bottom, oyster shells. Closed July–August.

spots.name: Lac de Monteynard
spots.notes: Famous thermal spot: strong south wind in spring and summer afternoons, north return wind. Main launches at Treffort. Shoreline bends here (84° locally vs 37° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Lacanau-Océan
spots.notes: Waves, experienced riders. Summer: kiting before 19:00 only in the Super-Sud zone.

spots.name: Lac de Lacanau
spots.notes: Lake: flat water; use the marked channel in summer. Shoreline bends here (219° locally vs 257° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Lac d'Hourtin-Carcans
spots.notes: Lake: flat water; stay south of the yellow buoy line. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Le Verdon – La Chambrette
spots.notes: Estuary beach for E to NE winds, 2 h either side of high tide. Shoreline bends here (65° locally vs 36° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: La Palmyre – Bonne Anse
spots.notes: Sheltered shallow bay, best on the rising tide (strong ebb currents).

spots.name: Lac du Bourget – Aix-les-Bains
spots.notes: Kite club zone at Aix-les-Bains: ride fast and jump only beyond the yellow buoys (200 m). 'La Traverse' W thermal, late afternoon; erratic: advanced riders.

spots.name: Oléron – Gatseau
spots.notes: Shallow south-facing bay; flat around high tide.

spots.name: Oléron – La Perroche
spots.notes: Rocks, intermediate riders; banned in summer.

spots.name: Oléron – Plaisance
spots.notes: Works N to E, all tides; marked kite zone in summer.

spots.name: Oléron – Plage des Huttes
spots.notes: Flat basin behind the reef around low tide, shore break at high tide. Avoid the bathing zones in summer.

spots.name: Châtelaillon-Plage
spots.notes: Kite area south of the main beach; all tides.

spots.name: La Rochelle – Aytré
spots.notes: Muddy shallow bay, ride 2 h either side of high tide; works SW to NW.

spots.name: Île de Ré – Rivedoux
spots.notes: North beach, marked kite zone; flat, works NW to NE. Oyster beds reduce space at low tide. Shoreline bends here (333° locally vs 6° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Île de Ré – Les Portes (Trousse-Chemise)
spots.notes: Flat shallow bay with a sandbank at low tide; works N to E. Strong currents near the Fier d'Ars. Shoreline bends here (68° locally vs 100° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: La Tranche-sur-Mer
spots.notes: Plage du Phare, facing Île de Ré: waves and current, good level needed. May–September: the only beach where kiting is allowed.

spots.name: Bretignolles-sur-Mer
spots.notes: Kite zone on the Plage des Dunes, buoyed in July–August.

spots.name: Notre-Dame-de-Monts
spots.notes: Wide beach at low tide.

spots.name: Fromentine
spots.notes: Flat water in the channel facing Noirmoutier, best 2 h either side of low tide. Summer: kite zone right of the bathing area; keep out of the ferry channel.

spots.name: Saint-Brevin-les-Pins
spots.notes: 15 June–15 September (and weekends from May): kiting only in the signposted zone, schools at the Plage du Billard.

spots.name: La Baule
spots.notes: Plage Benoît: flat water behind the sandbank at low tide, kite schools. 15 June–15 September: banned from the beach, experienced riders only via the K13 channel at the La Baule / Pornichet border.

spots.name: La Turballe – Pen Bron
spots.notes: Wave spot, shore break; little beach at high tide (sea wall).

spots.name: Assérac – Pont-Mahé
spots.notes: Shallow bay, you can stand almost everywhere; kite schools.

spots.name: Sarzeau – Penvins
spots.notes: Shallow basin, flat around high tide; beginner-friendly.

spots.name: Penthièvre
spots.notes: Bay side of the Penthièvre isthmus (flat water, oyster shells) and ocean side. Only 3 h either side of low tide. Late May–mid September: bay side banned, ocean-side kite zones at accesses 1 and 10–11.

spots.name: Plouharnel – Les Sables Blancs
spots.notes: Bay side of the Quiberon isthmus for NE to SE winds; best at low to mid tide, choppy higher up. Avoid the oyster parks (poles, yellow buoys ~500 m out); wear booties. Shoreline bends here (75° locally vs 50° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Erdeven – Kerhillio
spots.notes: Ride from 3 h before to 3 h after low tide. 15 June–15 September: kite zone in the east sector (beach accesses 27–28); banned around high tide at big coefficients (> 85).

spots.name: Gâvres
spots.notes: Ocean beach (waves) or the flat Petite Mer de Gâvres from mid tide.

spots.name: Fort-Bloqué
spots.notes: Waves; rocks mid-spot, best mid to low tide.

spots.name: La Torche
spots.notes: Kiters launch north of the point (Tronoën), away from the surfers; waves.

spots.name: Mousterlin
spots.notes: Shoreline bends here (236° locally vs 201° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Île-Tudy
spots.notes: Flat shallow water at low tide and early flood; works E to SW. Summer: banned 12:00–19:00, keep out of the bathing zones.

spots.name: Bénodet – Lagune du Letty
spots.notes: Flat-water lagoon (Mer Blanche) behind the dune spit, launch at the slipway below the UCPA. Around high tide, preferably on the flood (strong ebb currents); best in S to E winds.

spots.name: Crozon – Goulien
spots.notes: Waves; main kite beach of the Crozon peninsula.

spots.name: Lac d'Orient – Mesnil-Saint-Père
spots.notes: Experienced riders, March to October, through the local clubs (AWA, Flysurf10); beaches closed 15 June–15 September.

spots.name: Brest – Moulin Blanc
spots.notes: Flat water in the Rade de Brest, gusty wind. Closed 1 July–31 August 09:00–19:00.

spots.name: Hillion – Bon Abri
spots.notes: Bay of Saint-Brieuc: huge tidal range, ride mid to high tide. Nature reserve nearby.

spots.name: Lac du Der – Giffaumont
spots.notes: Kite zone regulated by the local club (KDA); red zone closed 15 June–15 September. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Plérin – Les Rosaires
spots.notes: Easterly-wind spot; busy with families in summer, ride off-season.

spots.name: Lampaul-Ploudalmézeau – Trois Moutons
spots.notes: Tréompan dunes; calm water, beach narrows at high tide. Summer kite zone.

spots.name: Landéda – Sainte-Marguerite
spots.notes: Sheltered; flat water at low tide. Summer kite zone.

spots.name: Cherrueix
spots.notes: Bay of Mont-Saint-Michel: huge tidal range; ride around high tide.

spots.name: Lancieux
spots.notes: Flat, shallow bay; best at low tide. July–August: Saint-Sieu beach is closed, launch at Tête de Chien (low tide) or Roche Morin (high tide).

spots.name: Erquy – Caroual
spots.notes: Kite zone away from the bathing area; best in SW to NW winds.

spots.name: Saint-Lunaire – Longchamp
spots.notes: Banned 10:00–20:00 from 15 June to 15 September.

spots.name: Sables-d'Or-les-Pins
spots.notes: Wide shallow beach, mixed sand / shallow water. Shoreline bends here (358° locally vs 328° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Keremma
spots.notes: 5 km of beach between the Kernic and Goulven bays; flat water at low tide.

spots.name: Saint-Malo – Le Sillon
spots.notes: 1 Jul–1 Sep: mandatory launch zone between the Kyriad hotel and Avenue Fuentès. Beach disappears at high spring tides.

spots.name: Jullouville
spots.notes: Best from mid to low tide.

spots.name: Lac de Madine
spots.notes: Club-only (AKL membership and FFVL licence required); main beach for SW–W winds, gusty. Shoreline bends here (218° locally vs 243° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Merville-Franceville
spots.notes: Dedicated kite zone at the west end of Boulevard Wattier, open all year (the only kite beach in July–August). Keep out of the bird reserve at the Orne estuary to the west.

spots.name: Ouistreham – Riva-Bella
spots.notes: Low tide only: at high tide the water reaches the sea wall.

spots.name: Asnelles
spots.notes: Mulberry harbour remains offshore; summer: kiting usually only outside bathing hours.

spots.name: Utah Beach
spots.notes: Huge beach; best at low to mid tide.

spots.name: Le Havre
spots.notes: Urban pebble beach, kite schools; works in SW to NW winds.

spots.name: Siouville-Hague
spots.notes: Wave spot, all tides.

spots.name: Cherbourg – Collignon
spots.notes: Flat water inside the Cherbourg breakwater, around high tide; works W to NE.

spots.name: Quiberville
spots.notes: Marked kite zone (mandatory); works WSW to NW. Pebble beach, sand at low tide.

spots.name: Cayeux-sur-Mer – La Mollière
spots.notes: Between Cayeux and Le Hourdel; kite schools and club in Cayeux.

spots.name: Le Crotoy
spots.notes: Tidal bay: rideable around high tide only. Do not cross the yellow buoys of the nature reserve.

spots.name: Fort-Mahon-Plage
spots.notes: Kite school zone north of the nautical base.

spots.name: Berck-sur-Mer
spots.notes: Huge beach; flat pools at low tide.

spots.name: Le Touquet
spots.notes: Launch north of Aqualud; the Canche bay works in E winds around high tide (strong currents).

spots.name: Hardelot
spots.notes: Flat water in the low-tide pools (baïnes) and waves outside.

spots.name: Le Portel
spots.notes: Kite school on the beach; waves in westerlies.

spots.name: Wimereux – Pointe aux Oies
spots.notes: Waves; Wimereux town beach only works at low tide, the Pointe aux Oies is the main launch.

spots.name: Wissant
spots.notes: Between the two capes (venturi): powerful wind and waves, experienced riders.

spots.name: Sangatte
spots.notes: Windiest spot of the Côte d'Opale, long waves; groynes on the beach. Kite school on site.

spots.name: Calais – Blériot-Plage
spots.notes: Watch the wooden groynes at high tide.

spots.name: Les Hemmes de Marck
spots.notes: Very wide gently sloping beach, flattish water behind sandbanks; best in NW to NE winds. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Gravelines – Petit-Fort-Philippe
spots.notes: 'Petite mer' behind the sandbank: flat water around high tide with big coefficients, open sea outside. Buoyed kite zone.

spots.name: Malo-les-Bains (Dunkerque)
spots.notes: Dunkerque Flysurfing Club beach; very wide at low tide.

spots.name: Bray-Dunes
spots.notes: Huge flat beach next to the Belgian border; shallow at low tide, more chop at high tide.

spots.name: Marazion – Long Rock
spots.notes: Mount's Bay, beginner friendly in the prevailing SW (cross-on).

spots.name: Gwithian
spots.notes: St Ives Bay. Kites off limits 10:00–18:00 from mid-July to early September and between the lifeguard flags.

spots.name: Bantham
spots.notes: Avon estuary mouth opposite Bigbury. Low tide to 1–2 h before high; stay right of the RNLI flags, 50 m from swimmers/surfers. Shoreline bends here (292° locally vs 257° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Perranporth (Perran Sands)
spots.notes: Kiting banned at the Perranporth town end all year: use the Perran Sands (north) end. Exposed, rips in bigger swell.

spots.name: Watergate Bay
spots.notes: Marked Kitesports Zone north of the rocks. No kiting 2 h either side of high tide; keep out of the lifeguard flags in season.

spots.name: Daymer Bay
spots.notes: Camel estuary, sheltered from swell. Kites banned 10:00–18:00 in July–August. Ride on the flood or slack; strong ebb.

spots.name: Weymouth – Portland Harbour
spots.notes: Flat water in most winds, any tide. Launch Ferrybridge / Hamm Beach; Portland Port permit and third-party insurance required. Fast ebb through Ferrybridge.

spots.name: Exmouth
spots.notes: Duck Pond: flat estuary lagoon, launch from the Imperial Recreation Ground; stay west of the yellow buoys 15 Sept–31 Dec (Brent geese). Seafront: ±2 h around high tide. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (307° locally vs 208° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Weymouth – Overcombe
spots.notes: Weymouth Bay: bump and jump, waves in easterlies.

spots.name: Studland – Knoll Beach
spots.notes: National Trust kite zone at the north end of Knoll Beach (not Shell Bay); NT permit required. Easterly-wind spot.

spots.name: Poole Harbour – Shore Road
spots.notes: Whitley Lake, Sandbanks: flat shallow harbour water; Poole Harbour Commissioners kite permit required. Best mid to high tide; boat traffic. Shoreline bends here (216° locally vs 244° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Ryde – Appley
spots.notes: Solent shore: shallow sandbars and pools at low tide, waist deep at half tide.

spots.name: Avon Beach (Mudeford)
spots.notes: Kite in the watersports area in front of the car park, never inside the summer swim zone.

spots.name: Bracklesham Bay
spots.notes: Long shallow beach, kite school; popular learning spot.

spots.name: West Wittering
spots.notes: Private estate beach: kitesurfing for 2XS members only, year round, launch in the buoyed area; no launching at high tide.

spots.name: Hayling Island
spots.notes: Official kite beach just east of the Beachlands funfair (free, no safety cover); CBK club at the west end. Keep 2 line lengths off the shore in swim season.

spots.name: Littlehampton
spots.notes: East Beach (Sea Road), BKSA school; flat knee- to waist-deep water around low tide.

spots.name: Pevensey Bay
spots.notes: Strict summer beach zoning (fines). Shingle at high tide, sand at low; bump and jump.

spots.name: Calshot
spots.notes: Spit at the mouth of Southampton Water: lagoons and sheltered water, kite school on site. Ship traffic in the channel.

spots.name: Lancing
spots.notes: Designated kitesports zone (beginner and advanced sections); stay out of the swim zones 1 May–30 Sept. Best 3–4 h either side of high tide.

spots.name: Camber Sands
spots.notes: Launch only in the year-round kite zone at the eastern (Jury's Gap / Broomhill) end. Best 3 h either side of low tide; groynes and shore break near high water.

spots.name: Greatstone (Littlestone)
spots.notes: Huge shallow bay, works in N–NE winds when the rest of the south coast does not. Long walk at low tide; avoid ±90 min around high tide if learning.

spots.name: Westward Ho!
spots.notes: 1 Jun–30 Sep kites only in the designated sand-sports zone (right of the lifeguard hut). Best around low tide; no riding at high tide.

spots.name: Saunton Sands
spots.notes: Kite zone starts past the White Rock marker ~400 m down the beach. No kitesurfing in July and August.

spots.name: Brean
spots.notes: Huge tidal range: very long walk over sand and mud at low water.

spots.name: Weston-super-Mare – Uphill
spots.notes: Dedicated kite zone at the Uphill end. 10 m+ tides: ride ~3 h either side of high tide only.

spots.name: Seasalter (Whitstable)
spots.notes: Shallow estuary flats; mid to high tide, long walk at low water.

spots.name: Minnis Bay
spots.notes: Thanet designated kite site, flat water in northerlies. Beach closed to kites ±2 h around high tide (sea wall). Shoreline bends here (323° locally vs 349° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Rest Bay (Porthcawl)
spots.notes: Any tide; Atlantic swell.

spots.name: Shoebury East Beach
spots.notes: Designated kite area; shallow lagoons between sandbanks at low tide, flat water, beginner friendly.

spots.name: Llangennith (Rhossili Bay)
spots.notes: Zoned surf beach, most swell on Gower; respect the surf zone.

spots.name: Freshwater West
spots.notes: Big surf beach with reef and strong currents: experienced riders only.

spots.name: Tenby – South Beach
spots.notes: Sheltered, flat; works SW round to NE, any tide.

spots.name: Frinton-on-Sea
spots.notes: Rig on the greensward. Ride mid to low tide: at high tide the sea reaches the sea wall.

spots.name: Newgale
spots.notes: Pembrokeshire's most popular kite beach, school on site. No launching at high tide.

spots.name: Felixstowe Ferry
spots.notes: Deben river mouth: mirror-flat lagoon on the ebb and at low tide; avoid the flood (current sets into the river).

spots.name: Kessingland
spots.notes: Council-approved kite zone, no groynes; large shallow pool at low tide. (Lowestoft main beach: kites Sept–May only.)

spots.name: Borth – Ynyslas
spots.notes: Dyfi estuary mouth: kite at high tide; strong tidal currents, no swimming.

spots.name: Sea Palling
spots.notes: Artificial offshore reefs: flat lagoons inside, punchy waves outside; strong rips at the reef gaps.

spots.name: Abersoch – Hell's Mouth
spots.notes: Porth Neigwl: waves, gusty; experienced riders.

spots.name: Black Rock Sands
spots.notes: Kitesurfing allowed all year (land kiting banned Mar–Nov). Flat in light winds, small waves in strong ones.

spots.name: Hunstanton
spots.notes: Flat shallow water over the sandbar at low tide; do not launch between the groynes. Rare west-facing east-coast beach.

spots.name: Brancaster
spots.notes: National Trust beach: use the marked kite launch zone at the beach entrance. Strong tidal streams, experienced riders only.

spots.name: Llanddwyn (Newborough)
spots.notes: Kites set up on the left-hand side of the beach only (turn left through the dunes). Any tide; boulders in places.

spots.name: Rhosneigr
spots.notes: Anglesey's main spot (Traeth Llydan / Crigyll): waves and big air. Rips near the river and the south end, yellow-buoyed lanes.

spots.name: Kinmel Bay
spots.notes: Flat water in WSW through N to NE. Council kite permit required (day or annual).

spots.name: West Kirby
spots.notes: Dee estuary: kite only around high tide (no kitesurfing within 100 m of the tide line otherwise).

spots.name: Hoylake – Red Rocks
spots.notes: Nature reserve, experienced riders. Mid to high tide on neaps; no beach left on big springs, long walk at low tide. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Wallasey (New Brighton)
spots.notes: Low tide lagoon or mid tide; do not kite inside the summer swim flags. Launch by Wallasey Beach Club (Coastal Drive). Shoreline bends here (290° locally vs 322° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Cleethorpes (Humberston)
spots.notes: Kites zoned south of the leisure centre (Thorpe Park / Humberston Fitties end). Lagoon around mid tide, beginner friendly.

spots.name: Ainsdale
spots.notes: Only Sefton beach where kitesurfing is allowed: free council permit plus BKSA insurance required.

spots.name: St Annes
spots.notes: Club spot by the Beachcomber café. Launch ~2 h before high tide; no beach on big springs, long walk at low.

spots.name: Cranfield
spots.notes: Carlingford Lough mouth: standing depth, boat traffic. Shoreline bends here (186° locally vs 216° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Walney Island – Earnse Bay
spots.notes: Gently shelving, exposed to the Irish Sea; kite school on the beach. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (176° locally vs 115° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Tyrella
spots.notes: Dundrum Bay: small kickers to medium waves, onshore beginner friendly in S.

spots.name: Cloughey
spots.notes: Ards Peninsula: flat water at low tide in easterlies.

spots.name: Strangford Lough – Newtownards
spots.notes: Kite community at Newtownards Sailing Club; good in southerlies, patchy in northerlies. Keep clear of birds (overwintering Oct–Mar, Brent geese from late Aug).

spots.name: Redcar – Majuba
spots.notes: Main Teesside spot, WNW through N to E. Rock reefs to the east uncover at low tide.

spots.name: Seaton Carew
spots.notes: Shallow, flattish water in southerlies (Tees estuary side).

spots.name: Ballyholme (Bangor)
spots.notes: Launch from the beach car park or yacht club; best in strong northerlies.

spots.name: Tynemouth – Longsands
spots.notes: Busy surf beach: keep clear of surfers and the lifeguard zone. Kiting banned at neighbouring Whitley Bay / Cullercoats.

spots.name: Blyth – Seaton Sluice
spots.notes: Kiters use the Seaton Sluice (south) end of the bay. Groynes and shore dump at high tide.

spots.name: Portstewart Strand
spots.notes: 3 km beach break, best W–SW with small swell; strong rips.

spots.name: Machrihanish
spots.notes: Kintyre's big Atlantic beach: launch near the village in SW, at Westport in S–SE. Shore break in W–NW.

spots.name: Beadnell Bay
spots.notes: Reef break plus lagoon, best mid to high tide; local BKSA school.

spots.name: Barassie
spots.notes: Troon's north bay; long, wide and flat, popular teaching spot.

spots.name: Budle Bay
spots.notes: Tidal lagoon: rideable from ~2 h before to a few hours after high water, chop only. Watersports zone open 1 Apr–31 Oct only (closed Nov–Mar for birds).

spots.name: Longniddry Bents
spots.notes: Edinburgh's main kite beach; best around low tide.

spots.name: Pettycur Bay (Kinghorn)
spots.notes: Best in SW; tide comes in fast, beginners at low tide only.

spots.name: Leven
spots.notes: One of the few east-coast spots for SW winds; shallow, beach parking.

spots.name: Tiree – Balephuil
spots.notes: Down-the-line waves in W; wind shadow at high tide.

spots.name: Monifieth
spots.notes: Tay estuary: SE–SW, wind accelerates in SW; flat, shallow, easy access.

spots.name: Tiree – The Maze
spots.notes: Open to all Atlantic swell; Tiree Wave Classic venue.

spots.name: Tiree – Gott Bay
spots.notes: Long shallow bay: beginner, freestyle and freeride; flat water in SW. Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Tiree – Balevullin
spots.notes: Tiree's best waves; limited kite space, rips at high tide, rocks.

spots.name: Tiree – Balephetrish
spots.notes: Reef-protected bay, flat water in most winds; big waves in N swell (experts).

spots.name: Tiree – Crossapol
spots.notes: Large easy beach; jumping in westerlies. Avoid the buoyed wreck.

spots.name: Aberdeen Beach
spots.notes: City beach for quick sessions: groynes, rip and onshore mess; Balmedie is usually better.

spots.name: Balmedie
spots.notes: Flat lagoons at low tide; rip strongest at mid tide, submerged posts at high tide.

spots.name: Newburgh (Ythan)
spots.notes: Ythan estuary flat water, 2–3 h either side of high tide.

spots.name: Nairn
spots.notes: Shallow, beginner friendly; kite school.

spots.name: Findhorn
spots.notes: Seaward beach; Findhorn Bay inside is flat around high tide.

spots.name: Fraserburgh
spots.notes: Large bay, best on the incoming tide; waves in W wind with NW swell.

spots.name: Prasonisi
spots.notes: Isthmus with two sides: waves on the west side and flatter water on the east side.

spots.name: Viganj (Pelješac)
spots.notes: Afternoon maestral.

spots.name: Neretva delta
spots.notes: Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain.

spots.name: Nin – Ždrijac
spots.notes: Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (211° locally vs 321° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Garrylucas
spots.notes: Cork's main kite beach (Garrettstown/Garrylucas), kite school; kickers in swell. SW best.

spots.name: Inch Beach
spots.notes: Wide sandy beach, flat to freeride.

spots.name: Tramore
spots.notes: Open beach for all levels; lagoon behind the dunes at high tide. Surfers at the town end.

spots.name: Lady's Island Lake
spots.notes: Brackish lagoon, standing depth, butter flat; best in southerlies. Keep away from the tern islands and the northern reserve (summer breeding). Irregular shoreline near the spot; orientation less certain. Shoreline bends here (39° locally vs 204° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Duncannon
spots.notes: Shallow flat water, kite school on the beach; choppy at high tide. W–S winds. Shoreline bends here (201° locally vs 233° over ±1.5 km).

spots.name: Brandon Bay (Castlegregory)
